subject: science

entries: Parts of a green plant: the leaf catches light, the stem holds the plant up, and the roots drink in water from the soil.
slots.label: Parts of a green plant
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Photosynthesis: plants make their own food: light, water and carbon dioxide arrive at the leaf and become food and oxygen.
slots.label: Photosynthesis
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Respiration: the reverse process: food and oxygen are broken down to release energy, making carbon dioxide and water.
slots.label: Respiration
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: A common mistake: plants do not breathe? Gases move in and out of the leaf all the time, so a plant respires day and night.
slots.label: Plants do not breathe?
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: The process by which green leaves use light, water and carbon dioxide to make food, releasing oxygen.
slots.label: Photosynthesis
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The process that breaks down food with oxygen to release energy, making carbon dioxide and water; it happens all the time.
slots.label: Respiration
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The part of the plant that catches light: the leaf is where photosynthesis makes food.
slots.label: Leaf
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The part of the plant that holds it up and carries water from the roots to the leaves.
slots.label: Stem
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The parts below the soil that drink in water for the plant.
slots.label: Roots
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: A gas in the air that the leaf takes in as one ingredient of photosynthesis.
slots.label: Carbon dioxide
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: A gas released by the leaf in photosynthesis, and taken in when food is broken down in respiration.
slots.label: Oxygen
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

title: Photosynthesis: how green plants make food
